prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1340; do not mention it.)
text:
I write to advise that this firm now represents the claimant in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes and was sideswiped by a vehicle insured under your policy. Our client has sustained injuries as a result of the incident and is currently receiving treatment.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, letter, or in person. Any requests for statements, recorded or otherwise, should be routed through us.

We also ask that you confirm in writing the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy in force at the time of the collision, together with the identity of any other policies that may apply.

Finally, we request that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes photographs, vehicle data and telematics, dashcam or surveillance footage, repair estimates, adjuster notes, witness statements, and any recorded communications. Please ensure that this material is not altered, discarded, or repaired without prior notice to this office.
